description: This file defines the OutboundMappingProcessor class, which handles processing and mapping outbound signals to external messages within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for initializing the processor, grouping signals by targets, applying message mappers, and handling mapping outcomes and errors.

classes.name: OutboundMappingProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of outbound signals, mapping them to external messages, and managing associated mappings, using provided configuration, mappers, and protocol adapters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate OutboundMappingProcessor with necessary configurations, mappers, and protocol adapter.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an OutboundSignal to produce a list of MappingOutcome objects, representing the success, drops, or errors of the mapping process.

methods.name: processMappableSignals
methods.description: Handles the grouping of signals and applies mappings for each group, resulting in mapping outcomes.

methods.name: runMapper
methods.description: Executes a single message mapper on the adaptable message, generating external messages or handling errors.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException with additional context.

methods.name: shouldMapMessageByConditions
methods.description: Determines whether a message should be mapped based on outgoing conditions and resolvers.
